findings.observation: Project-level deny Write(**/docs/**) and Write(**/configs/**) contradicts Devin profiles that must write those trees.
findings.method: read_file .devin/config.json vs .devin/agents/py-doc-bot/AGENT.md and py-config-bot/AGENT.md
findings.expected: Project permission matrix and profile allow-lists agree so py-doc-bot can write docs/ and py-config-bot can write configs/ without a blanket deny.
findings.actual: .devin/config.json deny lists Write(**/docs/**) and Write(**/configs/**); py-doc-bot allows Write(docs/**); py-config-bot allows Write(configs/**). DEVIN-RUNTIME.md mapping table documents those writes.
findings.impact: Devin config/docs tasks fail with permission denied, or operators flip to smart mode and over-grant. Critical Devin write path is uncontrolled relative to the documented profiles.
findings.root_cause: Project deny copied as a broad safety net without carving out the two write-capable profiles.
findings.remediation: Remove or narrow those two deny globs; keep Write(**/.env*) deny-only. Document deny-vs-profile precedence in DEVIN-RUNTIME.md.
validation: read .devin/config.json permissions vs each AGENT.md frontmatter
findings.automation: architecture test that deny globs do not cover profile allow Write() paths

findings.observation: JUNIE-RUNTIME claims check_junie_mirror.sh enforces content parity with CODEX-RUNTIME, but both files are runtime_only and the checker does not hash-compare them; WSL python already drifted.
findings.method: read JUNIE-RUNTIME.md, CODEX-RUNTIME.md, junie-mirror-contract.json, check_junie_mirror.py
findings.expected: Runtime-only maps either are hash-checked for shared closeout commands, or the docs say only profile-name/dashboard/forbidden-id semantics are enforced. WSL interpreter matches CODEX-RUNTIME / README.
findings.actual: Contract runtime_only_files lists CODEX-RUNTIME.md and JUNIE-RUNTIME.md separately. check_runtime_semantics only extracts py-* table names, forbidden identifiers, and .junie/skills/observability-* refs. JUNIE-RUNTIME:126-127 uses .venv/bin/python on WSL/Linux; CODEX-RUNTIME:110-113 prefers ${BIOETL_WSL_VENV_DIR:-$HOME/.venvs/bioetl}/bin/python.
findings.impact: Junie agents on WSL may validate with a different interpreter than the project canonical venv, causing false pass/fail. Operators over-trust the parity checker for runtime-map text.
findings.root_cause: Overstated enforcement sentence plus allowed runtime_only divergence without a shared closeout-command contract.
findings.remediation: Align the WSL python sentence with CODEX-RUNTIME.md; replace 'content parity is enforced' with the actual check_runtime_semantics scope.
findings.automation: extend check_runtime_semantics to require BIOETL_WSL_VENV_DIR in JUNIE-RUNTIME.md

findings.observation: Write(**/.env*) appears in both ask and deny; Read(**/.env*) appears in both ask and allow.
findings.method: read_file .devin/config.json
findings.expected: Env writes are deny-only with no ask prompt. Env reads may be allow (AGENTS.md permits reading).
findings.actual: ask includes Read(**/.env*) and Write(**/.env*); allow includes Read(**/.env*); deny includes Write(**/.env*). Precedence is undocumented.
findings.impact: If ask wins, the agent can prompt the user to authorize .env mutation, weakening the per-task explicit-approval guardrail. If deny wins, ask is dead/confusing.
findings.root_cause: Overlapping permission buckets without a documented merge rule.
findings.remediation: Keep Write(**/.env*) only in deny. Keep Read(**/.env*) only in allow. Document merge order.

findings.observation: Read-only Devin profiles grant unrestricted Exec(python) while denying write/edit tools.
findings.method: read_file Devin AGENT.md frontmatter for py-audit-bot, py-debug-bot, py-test-bot
findings.expected: Read-only roles cannot mutate the workspace. Exec allow-list is limited to non-mutating commands, or the runtime sandboxes python writes.
findings.actual: py-audit-bot allowed-tools includes exec; permissions allow Exec(python) and deny write/edit. Same pattern on py-debug-bot and py-test-bot. Whether Devin enforces deny after exec is not proven in-repo.
findings.impact: A 'read-only' audit/debug/test subagent can write files via python if the runtime only filters Write/Edit tools. Residual sandbox bypass risk.
findings.root_cause: Tool deny list does not constrain exec payloads.
findings.remediation: Drop Exec(python) from read-only profiles or wrap exec in a deny-write supervisor. State the runtime guarantee in DEVIN-RUNTIME.md if already enforced.
validation: review AGENT.md frontmatter; confirm Devin exec sandbox behavior (external)
